unit: Geometry · Chapter XI. Areas and volumes
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 9 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: The volume of a right prism is the base area times the height: V = S · h.
stages.headlineEnglish: The volume of a right prism is the base area times the height: V = S · h.

stages.headline: Example: the base is a right triangle with legs 3 and 4, h = 10 ⇒ S = 6, V = 60.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: the base is a right triangle with legs 3 and 4, h = 10 ⇒ S = 6, V = 60.

stages.headline: A cuboid is also a right prism: V = ab · c.
stages.headlineEnglish: A cuboid is also a right prism: V = ab · c.
